how.heading: How keys work
how.shown: A key is shown once, when it is created. Helpdock stores only its SHA-256 hash, so a lost key is revoked and replaced, never recovered.
how.reach: Each key reaches this brand only, and only what its scopes allow. A request over the key's rate limit gets 429 with Retry-After.

banner.body: {{n}} deliveries in a row used up all their retries; the last answer was {{answer}} on {{date}}. Nothing is sent to it until it is turned back on; events in between are not queued.

form.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL, starting with https://.
form.secretNote: A signing secret is created with the endpoint and shown once.

refusals.webhook-https-required: Use https://. Webhooks are never sent over plain HTTP.
refusals.webhook-destination-blocked: Address resolves to a private network ({{address}}) — refused. Helpdock only delivers to public addresses.
refusals.webhook-destination-blocked-unknown: That address is private — refused. Helpdock only delivers to public addresses.

created.title: Endpoint added
created.warning: It is shown only this once; rotate it if it is lost.

rotated.title: Copy your new signing secret
rotated.warning: Helpdock stores the secret encrypted and never shows it again; rotate it if it is lost.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate the signing secret?
rotateConfirm.body: Deliveries are signed with the new secret at once, and the old one stops verifying. The new secret is shown once.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{url}}?
deleteConfirm.body: Nothing more is sent to it, and its delivery log is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.

log.heading: Delivery log
log.caption: newest first
log.empty: No deliveries yet. Send a test event to see one here.

progress.skipped: Not sent: the endpoint was off

schedule.heading: When a delivery fails
schedule.body: Any answer other than 2xx, no answer within {{timeout}} s, a redirect or a refused address counts as a failure. Helpdock tries again, up to {{max}} attempts in all:
schedule.label: Retry schedule
schedule.after: After the last one, the delivery is marked failed and can be replayed by hand. Replay sends the same event id, so a receiver that stores ids sees it once.

detail.noHeaders: Not sent yet: the headers, and the signature, are made when it is.
detail.signatureNote: The signature is an HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body under this endpoint's signing secret.
detail.responseNote: Helpdock keeps the status code and the first 1 KB of the body. Redirects are never followed and a response is never rendered.
detail.refusedNote: An operator can allow an internal range with OUTBOUND_ALLOW_CIDRS. Every refusal is logged with its destination.
detail.pick: Choose a delivery to see what was sent and what came back.
